WDT.Title: Downtime Timeline
WDT.NoSC: Simple Calendar is not active — the timeline uses core world time.
WDT.AllHidden: All characters are hidden — turn on “Hidden” in the toolbar to show them.
WDT.Quick.Rest: Rest (heal roll; does not use the day)
WDT.Cost.NotPaid: Not enough money for cost of living: {product} — nothing deducted
WDT.Pay.NotOwner: Only the character's owner can pay.
WDT.Plan.ClearDaysBody: Remove all activities from the painted cells (only the selected characters and days)? This cannot be undone.
WDT.Plan.Error: Failed to resolve the plan — see console (F12).
WDT.Mod.Hint: Paint day headers, set a multiplier (×1 = remove) and 'Apply'.
WDT.Standing.Label: Status
WDT.Standing.Tooltip: Standard of living → cost of living (not income). Left click: up, right click: down; you can type the status (e.g. "Silver 5"). ↺ resets to sheet status.
WDT.ExtendedMissing: The linked extended test no longer exists on the character sheet.
WDT.NotWFRP: This actor is not from the WFRP4e system — cannot resolve a test.
WDT.NoSkill: This activity has no skill/characteristic assigned.
WDT.Income.NoCareer: The character has no current career set — cannot resolve income.
WDT.Income.NoSkills: The current career has no income skills available on the sheet.
WDT.Income.Hint: On resolve the system rolls and pays out money based on the character's status.
WDT.Income.NoCareerOrSkills: No current career or income skills on the sheet — please complete the character sheet.
WDT.Field.Label: Name
WDT.Field.LabelPlaceholder: e.g. Forging armour, Learning to read…
WDT.Extended.Name: Test name
WDT.Confirm.DeleteBody: Are you sure you want to delete this activity? This cannot be undone.
WDT.Settings.DaysToShow.Name: Days (fallback)
WDT.Settings.DaysToShow.Hint: With Simple Calendar the timeline shows the whole calendar week (e.g. 8 days for WFRP) — this setting is only a fallback when Simple Calendar is disabled.
WDT.Settings.costBrass.Name: Cost of living: Brass (per level)
WDT.Settings.costBrass.Hint: Cost of living in brass pennies (bp) per 1 standing level for Brass status. Daily cost = this value × standing (12 bp = 1 ss, 240 bp = 1 gc; fractions rounded on payment).
WDT.Settings.costSilver.Name: Cost of living: Silver (per level)
WDT.Settings.costSilver.Hint: Cost of living (bp) per 1 standing level for Silver status. Daily cost = value × standing.
WDT.Settings.costGold.Name: Cost of living: Gold (per level)
WDT.Settings.costGold.Hint: Cost of living (bp) per 1 standing level for Gold status. Daily cost = value × standing.
WDT.Settings.healBrass.Name: Healing: Brass (formula)
WDT.Settings.healBrass.Hint: Healers' surcharge per EACH ailment — a formula with variables 'daily' (day cost) and 'standing'. Default 'daily - 3'. Examples: 'daily - 2', 'standing * 3'. Invalid formula = 0.
WDT.Settings.healSilver.Name: Healing: Silver (formula)
WDT.Settings.healSilver.Hint: Surcharge per EACH ailment — formula ('daily', 'standing'). Default 'standing * 5'.
WDT.Settings.healGold.Name: Healing: Gold (formula)
WDT.Settings.healGold.Hint: Surcharge per EACH ailment — formula ('daily', 'standing'). Default 'standing * 30'.
WDT.Settings.rollModBrass.Name: Downtime modifier: Brass (per level)
WDT.Settings.rollModBrass.Hint: Modifier to the TARGET of rolls made from the timeline (Test / Extended / Income) based on sheet status. Rate per 1 Brass level; summed cumulatively up the ladder (Brass→Silver→Gold), rounded up. Timeline rolls only. 0 for all = disabled.
WDT.Settings.rollModSilver.Name: Downtime modifier: Silver (per level)
WDT.Settings.rollModSilver.Hint: Modifier rate per 1 Silver level (cumulative after full Brass). Default 1.
WDT.Settings.rollModGold.Name: Downtime modifier: Gold (per level)
WDT.Settings.rollModGold.Hint: Modifier rate per 1 Gold level (cumulative after full Brass and Silver). Default 1.5.
WDT.Settings.PostCost.Name: Cost-of-living cards
WDT.Settings.PostCost.Hint: Whether to auto-post a 'Pay' chat card with the cost of living after realizing a day.
WDT.Settings.AutoAddIncome.Name: Auto-add income money
WDT.Settings.AutoAddIncome.Hint: When enabled, a single income roll adds the money to the character sheet immediately (in bp). Off by default — money is added via the Income Scaler 'Apply' button. Batch mode always credits money.
WDT.Settings.AutoPayCost.Name: Auto-pay cost of living
WDT.Settings.AutoPayCost.Hint: Only works when 'Cost-of-living cards' is enabled. When on, the cost of living is deducted from the character sheet immediately and a confirmation is posted instead of a clickable 'Pay' card. In planning mode (multiple days) it is a single combined deduction for the whole period. If there is not enough money, nothing is deducted (a notice is shown).
WDT.Settings.DoubleIncomeFirstDay.Name: Double income on the first day of the week
WDT.Settings.DoubleIncomeFirstDay.Hint: Houserule: on the first day of the week (Imperial calendar via Simple Calendar) income is doubled (2× standing → double the dice). Requires Simple Calendar.
WDT.Settings.MergeAdjacent.Name: Merge adjacent identical days
WDT.Settings.MergeAdjacent.Hint: Visual only: runs of consecutive days with the same type, name and cost show as one bar with a range and summed cost. Counting and deletion remain per day. Per-user setting.
